After fixing [[Arah]]'s [[Printypress]], the Player will start to earn friendship points when talking to the [[Characters|befriendable NPCs]]. The Player can earn 10 points by talking to them once daily and 50 points when fulfilling a [[Hankerbot|hanker]] request. Points can also be earned when fulfilling tasks given by the [[Characters| befriendable NPC]]. When the player reaches 100 (this number may increase in tandem with the increase of friendship level. Needs verification.) friendship with a [[Characters| befriendable NPC]], they are rewarded a sticker and some other items, such as [[food]], [[Ooblet Accessories|Ooblet accessories]], [[Manatwee| furniture]], [[Meeds Seeds|seeds]], [[Tools|instruments]], and [[Gummies]].
